name: Alistair Davies
bio:
Alistair's fascination with motorsport began in his youth, fueled by countless hours spent tinkering with go-karts. After graduating with a degree in Mechanical Engineering, he honed his skills in various simulation roles, from aerospace to automotive, before finding his true calling in motorsport. He thrives on the challenge of translating real-world physics into a virtual environment, meticulously refining the simulator to provide drivers with the most accurate and immersive experience possible.

Alistair is known for his innovative approach to simulator development. He continually seeks out new technologies and methodologies to enhance the realism and effectiveness of the simulator. He's particularly interested in incorporating haptic feedback systems and advanced data analytics to provide drivers with a more nuanced understanding of vehicle dynamics. His detail-oriented nature and passion for pushing the boundaries of simulation technology make him a valuable asset to ProSport Racing.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly trimmed, slightly receding hairline
physical.description: Alistair is of average height with a focused, intense gaze.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with technical diagrams and calculations.
Has a habit of tapping his pen against his teeth when deep in thought.
Insists on calibrating the simulator's steering wheel before every session, regardless of whether it needs it.
